prompt_en: Create an environmental photograph in a moonlit tidal greenhouse laboratory. An unmistakably adult soft-robotics engineer derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair kneels beside a saltwater channel and guides a manta-shaped biohybrid robot with a narrow light wand. The complete manta-shaped biohybrid robot operating as an independent non-humanoid robot is an independent non-humanoid organism-machine: translucent polymer ribs, embedded microelectrodes, and flexible engineered fins surround clearly visible pink living muscle bands. A close material view reveals translucent polymer ribs embedded microelectrodes and flexible engineered fins meeting wet muscle at visible anchors. Contracted and relaxed tissue regions visibly bends the synthetic scaffold; wet muscle pulls anchored ribs to flex both fins between mangrove roots. Fine cables end at the robot rather than entering the engineer's body. Use a medium-wide three-quarter composition keeping the separate operator, complete machine silhouette, and working organic-synthetic junction readable together. Silver moonlight and amber grow lamps graze wet tissue, electrodes, and polymer edges above rippling caustics, cultured tissue trays, and instrument bridges.
